name: Gray Janssen
source:
This smug specimen is Gray, your rival gang leader in high school. Except he doesn't know that you're the leader and ends up taking a liking to you. 

Years later, you meet Gray again when you've started your own boutique. He demands you rent out your basement to him, so he can run his 'board gaming group'. Except you start hearing strange sounds coming from the basement... 

Once a delinquent, always a delinquent?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/939330/Tailor_Tales/]Steam[/url]]
